search_text: published ZDI-22-872 ZDI-CAN-16710 DevExpress SafeBinaryFormatter Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2022-06-24 CVE-2022-28684 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2022-28684 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['DevExpress'] ['DevExpress'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of DevExpress. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SafeBinaryFormatter library. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. The following updates resolve this issue: v22.1.1, v21.2.7, v21.1.9, v20.2.11, v20.1.15, v19.2.14, v19.1.15. v18.2.17, v18.1.18 ['2022-03-16 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2022-06-24 - Coordinated public release of advisory'] Markus Wulftange (@mwulftange) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-22-872/
title: DevExpress SafeBinaryFormatter Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of DevExpress. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SafeBinaryFormatter library. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
